skills.summary: Rewrite a weak prompt to be clear and testable
skills.job: Diagnose what is vague in a prompt, rewrite it with goal, context, constraints and output format, and explain each change.
triggers: improve this prompt
rewrite my prompt
why does my prompt give bad answers
gotchas: No test of the new version

skills.summary: Design a system prompt for an assistant
skills.job: Write a system prompt with role, scope, rules, tone, tool use and failure behaviour, then test it on sample inputs.
triggers: write a system prompt for
design the instructions for my assistant
create a bot prompt

skills.summary: Build few-shot examples that teach a pattern
skills.job: Select and write input and output examples that cover the task range, format and edge cases without leaking one pattern.
triggers: add examples to my prompt
build few-shot examples
give the model examples of the format

skills.summary: Build a test set to score a prompt
skills.job: Create a labelled set of cases with expected behaviour and a scoring rubric, so prompt changes can be compared fairly.
triggers: make a test set for my prompt
how do I evaluate this prompt
build an eval for my prompt
gotchas: Rubric that cannot be applied twice the same way

skills.summary: Prompt a model for reliable JSON or fixed output
skills.job: Specify a schema, an example and failure handling so model output can be parsed, and add validation and retry on the code side.
triggers: get json out of the model
force a fixed output format
make the model return structured data

skills.summary: Harden an LLM app against prompt injection
skills.job: Map where untrusted text enters a prompt, separate it from instructions, limit tool power and add checks on output.
triggers: protect my app from prompt injection
is my llm app safe from injected instructions
secure my agent against malicious pages
gotchas: No test of real attack strings

skills.summary: Design the prompt for document-grounded answers
skills.job: Write the prompt that gives retrieved passages to a model with citation, refusal and conflict rules, and plan the retrieval checks.
triggers: design a rag prompt
answer from my documents only
make the model cite retrieved passages

skills.summary: Write instructions for a tool-using agent
skills.job: Write agent instructions covering goal, tools, when to ask, stop conditions, safety limits and reporting format.
triggers: write instructions for my agent
create an agents file
how should I instruct a coding agent
gotchas: Listing tools without when to use them
Rules that need reading the whole repo

skills.summary: Compare two prompts fairly on the same cases
skills.job: Run two prompt versions over the same cases, score with one rubric and report the difference with its uncertainty.
triggers: which prompt is better
compare two prompt versions
a/b test my prompts

skills.summary: Grade model outputs against a rubric
skills.job: Grade a batch of model outputs with a written rubric, per-criterion scores and evidence quotes, and flag grader uncertainty.
triggers: grade these model answers
score the outputs of my prompt
review llm responses against criteria

skills.summary: Write a persona prompt that stays consistent
skills.job: Define a persona voice, knowledge limits and boundaries with sample lines, and test it for drift across turns.
triggers: write a character prompt
make the assistant speak in a voice
create a persona for my bot
gotchas: Voice that drifts after a few turns

skills.summary: Structure multi-step reasoning in a prompt
skills.job: Split a hard task into stages with checks in the prompt or the code, deciding when to ask for steps and when to chain calls.
triggers: make the model reason step by step
break this prompt into stages
the model skips steps on hard problems
gotchas: Asking for steps on a trivial task
Trusting stated reasoning as the real cause
Stages with no check between them

skills.summary: Brief for choosing between AI models
skills.job: Define criteria and a test plan for choosing a model for a task, and collect current facts from live docs instead of memory.
triggers: which model should I use for this
compare ai models for my task
help me choose an llm
gotchas: Stating versions, prices or limits from memory
Benchmarks that do not match the task
Ignoring latency and cost at volume

skills.summary: Defensive review of a prompt's weak points
skills.job: Review a system prompt for gaps that let users override its rules, and propose defensive fixes and tests, without writing attacks for use elsewhere.
triggers: review my prompt for weaknesses
can users bypass my bot rules
harden my system prompt
gotchas: Writing attack text for third-party systems
